query: Wan2.2 I2V KJ workflow crashes at WanVideoSampler with 'The size of tensor a (212160) must match the size of tensor b (210600)' when generating at 1920x1080. Smaller resolutions work fine; the mismatch appears in the latent/image conditioning tensors.

desired.outcome: kijai (owner): 1080 is not a supported dimension for the model because it does not divide by 16; use 1088 (or any multiple of 16) instead. Original poster confirmed understanding; issue closed.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: tests whether solver knows latent dims must divide by 16 and checks resolution multiples before suspecting the workflow
